name: view_strip_tiles_without_seams
description: The resource strip (the hub's place strip, the match's top strip) repeats its bar tile by tile, and no tile's edge shows: Godot tiled the nine-patch's centre inside one quad, and where its texture coordinates wrapped the mipmapped art fell to its smallest mip and drew a dark hairline down the strip every 128 px, under the gilt edge and through the text (review round 2). HdStyleBox now draws each tile as a quad of its own. Rendered, the hub's strip over the plain sky has no column darker than its neighbours in the shadow below the gilt.

steps.msg: online, the place strip is more than two tiles wide (an 88-texel cap, then 256-texel tiles)
so its bar is drawn tile by tile, one quad each
no hairline hangs below the strip's gilt edge (rendered runs; a headless run has no pixels)
the match's top strip is drawn tile by tile too
